iti47:1.1: This was said by the Blessed One, said by the Arahant, so I have heard:
iti47:2.1: “Monks, a monk should be wakeful: mindful, alert, centered, sensitive, clear, & calm. And there he should, at the appropriate times, see clearly into skillful mental qualities.
iti47:2.2: For a monk who is wakeful–mindful, alert, centered, sensitive, clear, & calm, seeing clearly, at the appropriate times, into skillful mental qualities–one of two fruits can be expected:
iti47:2.3: either gnosis right in the here-&-now, or–if there be any remnant of clinging-sustenance–non-return.”
iti47:3.1: Those who are wakeful, listen to this!
iti47:3.2: Those who are sleeping, wake up!
iti47:3.4:
For those who are wakeful,
there’s no danger, no fear.
iti47:4.3:
rightly exploring the Dhamma
at appropriate times,
iti47:4.4:
he–on becoming unified–
could shatter the darkness.
iti47:5.3: cutting the fetter of birth & aging–
iti47:5.4:
touches right here
a self-awakening un-
surpassed.
